title: Head opened - how the boards sit in the housing
source: FCC ID 2APBOAN600, internal-photos exhibit 3999178 (2018 sample), page 1, top photo (808x666)

callouts.label: Main board (component side up) on the front bezel
callouts.note: Board is heat-staked to the white bezel (community report). The component side with all debug points faces into the housing, so it is accessible without de-staking.

callouts.label: 30-way FFC ribbon: main board to power board
callouts.note: Release by lifting the grey latch of the FPC socket. Never pull the ribbon.

callouts.label: Yellow/black speaker wires from main J9 into the housing
callouts.note: Speaker per a community repair report. Unplug before removing the bezel assembly completely.

callouts.label: Protective earth wiring (green/yellow) + blue crimp splice
DIP switch (orange), reachable once the head is open
Adhesive residue on housing rim (front glass was glued here)
callouts.part: black adhesive/sealant bead, all around the opening
callouts.note: The black glass front is bonded to this rim. Cut the bead with a thin blade, then lift the glass.

callouts.label: Screw bosses holding the bezel + main board (3 of 4 visible)
callouts.note: Four plastic screws (community report). The 4th boss is hidden behind the ribbon. Matching holes in the white bezel corners.

callouts.label: Black round part where the yellow/black pair ends
callouts.note: Probably the speaker (fits the community report), or a grommet.
